headline: Executive order signed by President Clinton in 2000 dealing with the hiring and employment of Hispanic people in federal government jobs.
what_it_does: This executive order addresses the employment of Hispanic people in the federal workforce. No summary was provided, so the specific steps it requires of federal agencies cannot be described here with confidence.

who_it_affects.group: Hispanic job seekers and employees in the federal government
who_it_affects.how: The order concerns their hiring and employment in federal jobs, though the exact measures are not described in the available material.
Agencies are likely the ones directed to act on federal employment of Hispanic workers, but the specific duties are not stated in the source.
